cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Don't leave the allotment until we've weighed both pumpkins. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then you won't mind witnessing how much bigger.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow you'll say the scales were generous. Stay for the number.

mechanism: A keeps a pumpkin rival present by doing the lifting and giving B the weighing role rather than accepting a later report.
confusable: Unlike asking for praise, A requires B to stay until a witnessed number settles the contest.
comparison: Physical weighing and shared scale reading differ from inspecting a dinner bill before transfer.
seedUse: D194-a pumpkins and tomorrow offer; S02-a removes waiting work and delegates the decisive measurement to B.
